How this DeepSeek-V4.1 on A100x4 custom inference stack works:

Request intake & tokenization
A chat request is formatted with the model’s chat template and converted into token IDs.
Prefix cache lookup
The engine searches previous requests for the longest exact matching prefix.
If found, it restores a saved prefix snapshot. If not, it computes the prefix from scratch and saves a new snapshot.

Snapshot restore
The snapshot contains more than KV cache: sliding-window KV, compressed KV, index/compressor state, Engram history, shared-attention metadata, and optional speculative-decoding state.
Continuation replay
After restoring the snapshot, only the tokens after the cached prefix are recomputed. The full prompt does not need to be processed again.
Parallel execution
Performance is increased through several layers of parallelism:
• prefill pipelining across GPUs
• MoE expert parallelism
• batched decoding across requests
• CUDA Graphs to reduce launch overhead
• optional MTP / speculative decoding

The goal: reuse previous computation as aggressively as possible, minimize redundant prefill, and keep all 4× A100 GPUs busy during long-context inference.
DeepSeek-V4.1 custom inference on A100×4.
DeepSeek v4.1 Flash on A100x4のダッシュボードを作ったらより最適化すべきポイントが可視化された。Claude Codeが四回呼ぶと四回コンテキストを作ってせっかくのプロンプトキャッシュが効かなくなる。これはよくない。つまりベンチマーク上の最高速度と実用上の最高速度は違うということ。チューニングのしがいがあるぜ
